description: Fix the Issue Detail Workflow Profile UI so inherited profiles render as a read-only summary, custom profiles retain issue-owned YAML editing, loading and error states are explicit, and duplicate sidebar profile identity is removed.

tasks.title: Expose template source label
tasks.description: Add the optional workflow profile template source classification needed by the UI summary. Compute it from existing profile state and expose it through the existing workflow-profile read response and matching Web type without changing storage or workflow runtime behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The workflow-profile response includes an additive template source value of system, project, or custom.
The value is derived from existing source template and custom-template state without a schema migration or new endpoint.
The Web response type accepts the optional template source field while remaining compatible with responses that omit it.
tasks.output: Updated workflow-profile read response and Web response type with optional template source metadata.
tasks.notes: Keep this additive only; do not redesign profile merge semantics.

tasks.title: Add profile template delete mutation
tasks.description: Add the Web API helper and mutation hook for the existing DELETE workflow-profile template route. The mutation should invalidate or refresh the same workflow-profile query used by the editor so reverting can return the card to inherited mode after the server confirms the delete.
acceptanceCriteria: A Web client helper calls DELETE /projects/:projectId/issues/:number/workflow-profile/template.
A mutation hook is available to UI code and refreshes the workflow-profile query after success.
Mutation errors can be surfaced by the editor without replacing existing save validation behavior.
tasks.output: Web issue API client and query/mutation hook support for reverting an issue custom workflow template.
tasks.notes: Use the existing backend route; do not introduce a new API contract.

tasks.title: Render state-aware Workflow Profile card
tasks.description: Refactor the Issue Workflow Profile widget into explicit loading, error, reference, and custom branches. Reference mode must show a compact inherited summary and customize action, while custom mode must preserve the issue-owned YAML editor, save/discard/error behavior, and add the revert-to-inherited affordance.
acceptanceCriteria: Reference responses with yaml null and hasCustomTemplate false render Profile, Mode Inherited, Template, Overrides None, and Customize profile.
Reference mode renders no textarea, no Save button, and no visible Loading workflow profile... placeholder.
Loading mode renders a skeleton or loading indicator outside the textarea and does not use the editor placeholder.
Error mode renders a compact failure block with a retry control and no textarea placeholder fallback.
Custom mode renders the existing YAML editor populated from yaml and labels it as editing this issue's own workflow profile YAML.
Custom mode preserves existing save, discard, validation error, save error, dirty-state, and unsaved-changes behavior.
Custom mode shows a revert-to-inherited affordance that uses the delete mutation and returns to the inherited summary after the refreshed response is reference mode.
tasks.output: State-routed IssueWorkflowProfileEditor component with inherited summary, explicit loading/error states, custom editor, and revert support.
tasks.notes: Keep Coder Model and per-stage override controls out of this widget.

tasks.title: Clean up Issue Detail profile wording
tasks.description: Update the Issue Detail page so the Workflow Profile card is the single source of profile identity. Remove the duplicate Workflow Profile row from DETAILS and relabel active run YAML surfaces as runtime output rather than workflow profile configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: The DETAILS sidebar no longer renders a Workflow Profile label/value row when the main card is present.
DETAILS still shows issue metadata such as issue stage, workflow stage, project, and repository.
Existing Coder Model and per-stage override controls remain in ACTIONS and are not redesigned.
The active run YAML trigger and dialog are labeled as active/runtime run YAML, with copy clarifying it is rendered runtime output rather than issue profile configuration.
tasks.output: Issue Detail page with deduplicated DETAILS sidebar and runtime-oriented active run YAML wording.
tasks.notes: Only touch Issue Detail page copy and sidebar composition for this issue.

tasks.title: Cover profile card states with tests
tasks.description: Extend Web tests for the Workflow Profile card state model. Cover reference, custom, loading, and error branches, including placeholder absence, issue-owned editor labeling, retry affordance, customize action, and revert affordance behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Reference-mode tests verify inherited summary fields, Customize profile, no textarea, no Save button, and no Loading workflow profile... placeholder.
Custom-mode tests verify the editor renders populated YAML and is labeled as issue-owned workflow profile YAML.
Existing custom-mode save, dirty, discard, validation, and unsaved-changes test coverage still passes.
Loading-state tests verify a skeleton or loading indicator and no editor placeholder.
Error-state tests verify a compact error block, retry control, and no editor placeholder.
Revert tests verify the custom editor exposes a revert-to-inherited affordance and invokes the delete mutation path.
tasks.output: Updated IssueWorkflowProfileEditor Web tests covering all required card states and custom-mode behavior.
tasks.notes: Mock useIssueWorkflowProfileYaml per scenario rather than performing network calls.

tasks.title: Cover Issue Detail integration cleanup
tasks.description: Add or update Issue Detail page tests for the page-level information architecture changes. Verify the Workflow Profile card remains present, the DETAILS sidebar does not duplicate profile identity, ACTIONS controls remain available, and active run YAML copy is runtime-oriented.
acceptanceCriteria: A page-level test verifies the DETAILS sidebar does not contain a duplicate Workflow Profile row.
The test still verifies the Workflow Profile card is rendered as the profile identity source.
Tests confirm existing Coder Model and per-stage override controls are not removed by this change.
Tests verify active run YAML wording does not present runtime YAML as workflow profile configuration.
tasks.output: Updated IssueDetailPage Web tests for sidebar de-duplication, ACTIONS preservation, and active run YAML wording.
tasks.notes: Keep this at page level; widget branch coverage belongs in T-005.

tasks.title: Run focused Web verification
tasks.description: Run the relevant Web test suite after implementation and fix any regressions in the profile card and Issue Detail tests. Confirm the task outcomes with automated evidence and note any manual verification that remains useful for /issues/52.
acceptanceCriteria: The focused Web tests for IssueWorkflowProfileEditor pass.
The focused Web tests for IssueDetailPage pass.
No failing tests remain in the relevant Web package command caused by this change.
Verification notes identify the manual /issues/52 checks: inherited summary, no textarea, no disabled Save, no stale loading placeholder, no duplicate DETAILS row, and Active run YAML wording.
tasks.output: Passing focused Web verification results and manual check notes for issue 52.
tasks.notes: Use the package's documented Web test command; do not broaden into backend runtime changes unless tests expose a required additive response-field fix.
